  1. Another meme-filled game, ala Borderlands 2.
  2. A "gritty reboot" of the franchise.

The first would likely be able to be done fast, and would be most like the original game, but I don't know that anyone would want to play that. If you added multiplayer, then people might play online, but no one wants to be a bunch of Dukes fighting other Dukes, and spouting one-liners that aren't funny after 30 minutes.

The second might show a way forward for the series, but it would take a lot more work, and would alienate the remaining fan base for something which was, in all honesty, a kind of generic plot.
